help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Sign in to make a one-time payment from your checking or savings account, or enroll in Auto Pay.
Call 800-654-4566 any time for the automated system, or during business hours (weekdays 8 a.m. to 7 p.m., Saturdays 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. Central) for help. TTY users can call 800-946-7481.

Mail payments to Midland Mortgage, Attn: Payment Processing, P.O. Box 268888, Oklahoma City, OK 73126. Overnight payments go to 999 NW Grand Blvd, Suite 100, Oklahoma City, OK 73118. Wire transfers are also accepted; include your name, loan number and property address.

help.title: Auto Pay
paragraphs: Auto Pay withdraws your payment monthly on the day you choose, any day from your due date through the end of your grace period (the 1st through the 16th for most loans). Enroll online after signing in, or send the Auto Pay enrollment form with a voided check by email, fax or mail. Your loan must be current to enroll.
Keep paying by mail, online or by phone until you get a letter confirming your first withdrawal date and amount.

To change or stop Auto Pay, let us know at least three business days before a scheduled draft, online, by phone at 800-654-4566 or in writing. Three returned payments in 12 months end Auto Pay eligibility.

help.title: Mortgage assistance
paragraphs: Common plans include a partial claim (an interest-free loan from your investor or insurer due when the mortgage is paid off), a repayment plan, a loan modification and an unemployment plan with lower payments while you look for work. If you want to leave the home, a sale, short sale or deed-in-lieu may be possible.

After a disaster, a three-month forbearance lets you pause payments; interest still accrues, but no late fees are charged and the loan is not reported past due during the plan. Apply online or call 800-654-4566.
